editorialSummary: Nothing captures modern resource allocation quite like financial markets suffering a [massive AI sell-off](https://www.lemonde.fr/en/economy/article/2026/11/21/wall-street-reels-as-ai-linked-companies-spark-massive-sell-off-in-the-us_6785968_19.html) while hackers breach the [FBI crime database](https://www.foxnews.com/politics/fbi-probes-second-cyberattack-months-hackers-breach-key-crime-database-sources-say) and COP31 deadlocks over [phasing out fossil fuels](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6ly5w40eg07o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss). At least researchers are finding comfort knowing an [AI-assisted proof](https://www.newscientist.com/article/2600134-anthropic-mathematician-claims-ai-assisted-proof-of-the-riemann-hypothesis/?utm_campaign=RSS|NSNS&utm_content=home&utm_medium=RSS&utm_source=NSNS) finally conquered mathematics.
